requirements.Title: AI Productivity, Scan Workflow & Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-powered productivity, scan workflow, and manageability features into the Magellan printer to simplify business operations for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs require efficient, easy-to-manage solutions due to limited IT resources. AI-driven features will improve productivity and user experience.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires AI solution development and integration with printer firmware/software.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI-based scan and print workflow features are available and functional in the product; manageability features demonstrably reduce manual intervention for SMB users.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business TCO (Total Cost of Ownership)
requirements.Description: Ensure that the Magellan printer delivers the lowest total cost of ownership in its segment through efficient ink usage, minimal maintenance, and cost-effective supplies.
requirements.Rationale: Cost is a primary concern for SMBs. Offering the lowest TCO will drive adoption and competitive differentiation.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires optimization of ink system, maintenance cycles, and supply chain.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Independent benchmarking confirms Magellan has the lowest TCO among comparable SMB tank printers.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Design the maintenance box to be easily replaceable by the customer without the need for service technician intervention.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs lack dedicated IT support, so user-replaceable components minimize downtime and service costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Hardware design, service documentation, and training materials.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End users can replace the maintenance box following provided instructions without tools beyond those supplied; validated by usability testing.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Implement keyed ink bottle designs to prevent incorrect refilling and ensure compatibility with the Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents user error, reduces service calls, and protects printer health.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Only correctly keyed bottles can be used to refill the printer; tested in at least 95% of use cases with end users.

requirements.Title: SMB Portal for Device Management
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated web-based portal for SMBs to manage multiple Magellan printers, monitor usage, and access support resources.
requirements.Rationale: Unmanaged and lightly managed SMBs need centralized, simple tools for device management due to lack of IT staff.
requirements.Dependencies: Software development, telemetry integration, user authentication and security.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal is accessible, supports all Magellan printers, provides real-time monitoring, and scores >85% in SMB user satisfaction surveys.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS (Printing as a Service)
requirements.Description: Magellan must support HP’s Printing as a Service (PaaS) offering, enabling subscription-based models for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: PaaS is a strategic direction for HP and meets evolving business purchasing preferences.
requirements.Dependencies: Integration with HP PaaS backend systems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan is available as a PaaS offering in pilot markets at launch, with all required backend integrations functional.

requirements.Title: PDL/PS Support (Page Description Language/PostScript)
requirements.Description: Magellan must support industry-standard PDLs, including PostScript, to enable compatibility with business workflows and applications.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures compatibility with diverse business environments and software ecosystems.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer passes compatibility tests with major business applications requiring PDL/PS support.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification
requirements.Description: Design Magellan to meet Blue Angel environmental certification requirements.
requirements.Rationale: Environmental sustainability is a key differentiator and increasingly required by business customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Product design, materials sourcing, certification process.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan receives Blue Angel certification prior to launch.

requirements.Title: High-Speed Printing (25/20 ppm)
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan achieves print speeds of at least 25 ppm (black) and 20 ppm (color) for the PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Competitive print speeds are critical for business productivity and to match/exceed market standards.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves 25 ppm (black) and 20 ppm (color) in standard business print tests.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Magellan’s chassis and major plastic components must contain at least 60% recycled content plastic.
requirements.Rationale: Supports HP’s sustainability commitments and is a key purchase driver for SMBs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bill of materials and supplier documentation confirm 60% RCP for specified parts.

requirements.Title: Perfect Print and Perfect Scan AI Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate ‘Perfect Print’ and ‘Perfect Scan’ AI-driven features to optimize print quality and scan accuracy automatically.
requirements.Rationale: Differentiates Magellan with advanced, easy-to-use quality enhancements for SMBs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features demonstrably improve print and scan quality in lab and field tests; positive user feedback (>85% satisfaction).

requirements.Title: Maintenance Free or Reduced Maintenance Design
requirements.Description: Engineer Magellan to require minimal maintenance and reduce the number of parts needing replacement over the product’s life (target: fewer than leading competitors).
requirements.Rationale: Minimizes operational burden for SMBs without IT staff and reduces TCO.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magellan requires fewer maintenance interventions than leading competitors over a 2-year period.

requirements.Title: Warranty: 80,000 Pages or 2 Years
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty covering either 80,000 printed pages or 2 years, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: Provides assurance to SMBs and aligns with expected product lifecycle and usage.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are published and included with all Magellan units at launch.

requirements.Title: Customer Journey Support: Education, Setup, Install, and Registration
requirements.Description: Provide comprehensive onboarding materials and guided setup (digital and/or printed) to support SMB Office Managers and Generalist IT users through setup, installation, and registration.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures smooth adoption for non-IT-savvy customers, reducing support calls and increasing satisfaction.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: >90% of surveyed users report successful first-time setup and registration without external assistance.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing Support via HP App
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing capabilities through the HP App for Magellan users.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs increasingly use mobile devices for business tasks; mobile printing is a critical feature.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Users can print from major mobile OSes via HP App in >95% of test cases.

requirements.Title: Telemetry Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry features to collect anonymized usage and performance data for product improvement and proactive support.
requirements.Rationale: Supports ongoing product quality improvements and enables predictive support services.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is collected, anonymized, and available for analysis in compliance with HP privacy standards.
